◉ Local & intel alarm

Never get caught by a neutral again.

Recognizes standing icons

Red, orange and neutral icons are detected by their shape — red chat text is ignored.

Follows the client you play

Multibox? It watches the active window, or all of them, each with its own baseline.

Intel channels too

Beeps when a system within N jumps of you is reported in your intel channels.

  1. Take a photo of your EVE window and frame the local list.
  2. Choose what rings: reds, oranges, neutrals.
  3. Press Start. Pick your sound and volume.

Try it now — it's free

Support Cockpit with ISK

Cockpit is free, ad-free and developed on the side. If it saved you time, ISK or a fleet, an ISK donation keeps new features coming.

  1. Find the pilotIn game, search for the name below and open their info window.
  2. Right-click the portraitThen choose « Give Money ».
  3. Add a reasonWrite « Cockpit » so we know where the support comes from.

Even easier: in Cockpit, open « Support Cockpit » and click « Open their profile in my game ».

ISK is in-game currency and cannot be exchanged for real money, in line with EVE Online's rules. Every donor gets exactly the same Cockpit — no paid advantage, ever.
